title: Concept: SQL built by concatenation (python) — review required
description: In python, cursor.execute("SELECT " + col) mixes code and data in one SQL string. Concatenation is the classic injection primitive: quotes and keywords in the input rewrite the statement. The remedy is bound parameters via parameter placeholders (?/%s).
applicability: python codebases issuing SQL through the flagged call; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise (read, write, execute) when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
